source_line: Source: Adobe Analytics holiday forecast (2026); Deloitte Canada
caption:
Black Friday is breaking records — and so is the borrowing behind it.

Adobe expects a record $12.9 billion in U.S. online sales today, inside a record $275.1 billion online holiday season. The catch: a record $21.3 billion of that is going on Buy Now, Pay Later — the 'pay in 4' plans that split a purchase into four installments and follow you into January.

In Canada, the opposite mood: shoppers plan to spend about 5% less on gifts this year, per Deloitte.

My take: a deal you have to finance isn't really on sale. If 'pay in 4' is the only way the cart fits, the cart's too full.

Would you put a Black Friday buy on Buy Now, Pay Later?
